review_policy: Original PDF images versus existing OCR/frozen passage, not ranking-dependent relabeling. These are representation limitations, not a claim that they exclusively caused any model failure. Positive/negative relevance is unchanged.

C-Theorem-10.scope: raw OCR formula damage plus prose-filtered representation

C-Relation-09.evidence: Same original exercise 3.2.32; derivative order, denominator and limit relation absent from readable passage.

C-MethodSimilarity-09.evidence: Original PDF 64 shows repeated differentiation/l'Hopital steps for central high-order difference quotients. Existing OCR symbols are broken; the method is implicit in formulas and not explicit in encoded prose.

C-SimilarProblem-10.evidence: Solutions PDF 81 P254 exercise kernels n/(1+n^2 x^2) and normalized (x-a)^n are readable on the original; existing encoded passage contains '712 2 + 1', lost integrals and normalized factors.

C-HardNegative-10.evidence: Same solutions PDF 81 endpoint approximation; encoded text does not retain the complete kernel or normalization.

C-MethodSimilarity-10.evidence: PDF 81 P259 exercise original defines G(x)=integral from 0 to x of g(t), then uses integration by parts and Riemann lemma. Existing prose loses the integral definition and oscillatory integral target; a few periodicity sentences survive.

other_pages: All 25 source pages were visually inspected before dataset freeze. Every original formula was kept unchanged. Many OCR formulas are damaged even when prose is sufficiently readable to identify the target. Formula-heavy is pre-labelled in Test C; it is not automatically equated with OCR-limited. Unreviewed common failures must be marked undetermined, never Model Failure by default.
